newsitem.title: DUBAI: Syrian vice-president arives in Saudi for talks.
newsitem.headline: Syrian vice-president arives in Saudi for talks.

text.p: Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam arrived in Riyadh on Sunday for talks with Saudi officials on regional developments and bilateral ties, state-run Saudi television said.
Khaddam, accompanied by Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara, was greeted at the airport by Crown Prince Abdullah and Foreign Minister Prince Saud al-Faisal.
The television gave no further details. The two countries have warm ties.
